published_prior_art.cite: DwivediTianTomkinsKlasnjaMurphyShah2025, Counterfactual inference in sequential experiments: adaptive pooled unit-by-time causal factor inference, but via nearest neighbors rather than IPW-SVD.

CaiLiChiPoorChen2021Subspace, Theorem 2: minimax two-to-infinity subspace lower bound under independent Gaussian matrix noise; the causal predictable-mask embedding and claimed logarithmic frontier remain distinct.
KhanUgander2023AdaptiveNormalization studies scalar adaptive normalization, not a spectral total-drift characterization with a same-path row denominator.

BelloniOliveira2018MartingaleCLT gives high-dimensional martingale approximation, while XiaYuan2021LinearForms gives independent-sampling matrix-form inference; neither is the stated direct causal-IPW band.
No located paper computes this exact predictable-mask, normalized maximum-row minimax constant.

novelty_flags.label: thm:ipw-rowwise-upper and thm:adaptive-minimax-lower
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey misses Dwivedi et al. (2025, Annals of Statistics), a close published result on counterfactual inference in pooled sequential experiments with adaptive policies and unit-by-time factor structure.

novelty_flags.label: thm:ipw-rowwise-upper and thm:adaptive-minimax-lower
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed adaptive rate frontier cites Cai and Han only by bibkey in the gaps, without a theorem, equation, page, or quoted open-problem locator establishing the asserted unoccupied regime.

soundness_flags.label: ass:occupancy-growth
soundness_flags.one_line: With fixed q>0 and ass:aspect-ratio, mq/log(en) tends to infinity automatically along the stated triangular-array asymptotic regime, so this is not an independent load-bearing assumption.

soundness_flags.label: ass:blind-tangent-gap
soundness_flags.one_line: A high-probability singular-gap condition for the random post-normalization target T^B is load-bearing but has no independent applicability justification; derive it from primitive oracle-gap and tangent controls or retag it novel with such a justification.

soundness_flags.label: prop:markov-witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The witness only requires even n and m, but its claimed class membership and b_nm asymptotic require a bounded-aspect sequence; explicitly impose c_- <= m/n <= c_+ on the witness sequence.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:sharp-constant
soundness_flags.one_line: The liminf has no specified dimension path and the infimum does not specify estimators measurable with respect to the observed experiment (A,Y,p), so C_star is not yet a defined minimax functional.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 53(5), 2025, primary journal version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies a low-rank matrix contextual-bandit parameter, uses an online doubly-debiasing procedure built on stochastic-gradient estimation, and proves asymptotic-normal inference; it is not a batch IPW-SVD rowwise theorem.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and introductory description of adaptively weighted AIPW inference.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article develops adaptive weighting of AIPW terms for asymptotically normal policy-evaluation inference under adaptive experiments with known assignment probabilities.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 53(6), 2025, primary journal version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article allows pooled sequential adaptive treatment policies and establishes unit-by-time counterfactual error guarantees under a nonlinear latent-factor model using nearest neighbors.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Dwivedi et al. (2025) to the bibliography and state a precise inclusion or separation: identify which of its exogenous-noise/factor assumptions are relaxed by the predictable-IPW-SVD class, and formulate the strict rate or target improvement against it.

Turn the blind result into a constructive contribution by deriving the tangent gap from primitive oracle separation and path-stability conditions, or by proposing and analyzing a tangent-corrected blind score with an observable diagnostic.

Define the sharp-constant experiment on an explicit bounded-aspect sequence, restrict the infimum to measurable estimators of (A,Y,p), and make the Markov witness use the same sequence; remove the redundant occupancy assumption.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision: anchor the frontier against the missed sequential-experiment literature and repair the random-gap, witness-aspect, and minimax-functional specifications before advancing to Stage 0.
